Good Lord, this place is a slice of heaven! Pure bliss!
Aug 2026 • Family
We hit up MaXi's 2 over on Nguyễn Thiện Thuật, and let me tell y'all, we were completely blown away! It was an absolute delight from start to finish.The Pros:The Food: The seafood here is absolute fire! And that pasta and pizza? Hands down the best dang pies and noodles I’ve ever put in my mouth in all of Nha Trang.The Drinks: The booze and cocktails are top-shelf, super premium stuff. They ain't skimpin' on the good ingredients here.The Vibe & Crew: The whole joint is spotless clean and fresh as a daisy. Plus, the staff is completely outstanding—incredibly welcoming and sharp as a tack.

A must for connoisseurs!
Mar 2025 • Couples
You don't need to know the MAXI'S, you'll get fed up elsewhere. But if it's supposed to taste fantastic: nothing like that!

Only ten minutes from the beach, small but oho: Eleven tables, 32 seats. Stylish, friendly - and above all: sparkling clean! And as for prices: MAXI'S can also use mini...

We had bisque shrimp soup (about €5), T-bone steak (500 g/30), tenderloin (200 g/18), tasty-fresh San Miguel (0.5 /2.35) and signature espresso martini (3.20). Served by the sympathetic Mr. Shark, who also persuaded us to make the best currywurst outside Germany (6 €) - with potato salad based on a 50-year-old northern German family recipe. To kneel down!

It's just a pity that Mr. Do not take home: this is the cook.
